description: Valstybės duomenų agentūra: wastewater datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.lt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Valstybės duomenų agentūra. Coverage: Valstybės duomenų agentūra. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about wastewater; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Alytaus rajono savivaldybės įmonės "Simno Komunalininko" nuotekų debit; Nuotekų valymo įrenginiai bei jų lokacijos; Metinių nuotekų tvarkymo apskaitos ataskaitų duomenys. Formats seen: JSON, CSV, RDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.lt). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-lt.
